text:
lucas-fin: Greenspan Labs flagged their Private renewal invoice (GL-2026-10). There's an extra line 'REGION_SURCHARGE_APAC' for $9,600 on top of the platform fee. Customer says regional capacity was included in their Dedicated->Private migration SOW. Can billing confirm origin?

priya-ar: Paste the invoice lines? AP won't post ambiguous surcharge lines.

lucas-fin: Snippet (redacted):
```
Line 4: PLATFORM_PRIVATE - $120,000 - SKU PF-PRV-ENT-2026
Line 5: REGION_SURCHARGE_APAC - $9,600 - SKU PF-REG-APAC
Line 6: SUPPORT_TIER_GOLD - $30,000 - SKU SUP-GOLD
Total due: $159,600
```
Customer's SOW (SOW-GL-2026-03) lists global footprint included for the committed capacity.

emily-cs: I reviewed SOW-GL-2026-03. It includes a clause "regional expansion within committed capacity at no additional platform fee." There was an optional 'elastic burst' surcharge but Greenspan didn't opt in. Strange.

billing-bot: Billing run 2026-10-01: emit rule PF-REG-* creates separate surcharge line for region capacity when usage > regional cap. Generated ticket BILL-8222 for investigation.

steve-sales: We discussed a one-time onboarding surcharge during negotiation but never put it in the signed SOW. I have a slack thread where customer explicitly declined extra region charges. Let me pull that.

priya-ar: If this is a billing error we should reissue invoice. If it was a legitimate overage we need usage evidence and a signed amendment. Also check if APPR-2026-3045 (one-time regional surcharge approval) exists for this account.

kyle-ops: Ops note: monitoring shows Greenspan had a short burst into APAC capacity on 2026-09-27 for ~18 minutes above their per-region soft cap. That triggered automated surcharge calc in the billing pipeline. Looks like the pipeline doesn't apply the SOW exemption for Private deployments.

emily-cs: So two issues: (A) Billing pipeline rule triggered on short burst, (B) SOW exemption not applied. We should correct the invoice if the burst is within our tolerance or if SOW explicitly exempts it.

billing-bot: BILL-8222 assigned to @billing-ops. Subtasks: verify usage window, check SOW flags, look for approval APPR-2026-3045. ETA 3 business days.

priya-ar: Action items: 1) @billing-ops attach SOW-GL-2026-03 and ops burst logs to BILL-8222, 2) @steve-sales search for any signed amendment/approval (APPR-2026-3045) and upload if present, 3) @lucas-fin coordinate with customer AP and tell them we are investigating and will either reissue invoice or provide usage backup.

steve-sales: Found conversation where customer declined paid region expansion. No signed amendment. Uploading that thread link to the ticket.

lucas-fin: I'll notify Greenspan AP: "We received your question and are investigating. Billing ticket BILL-8222 opened; expect update within 3 business days."

billing-bot: Update on BILL-8222: billing rule modified to respect SOW exemption flag for Private accounts. For GL-2026-10, option A: reissue invoice GL-2026-10_R1 removing REGION_SURCHARGE_APAC. ETA 2 business days.

priya-ar: Great. Once billing reissues, AR please hold cash application until corrected invoice is uploaded.

kyle-ops: Noted. Also recommending a pipeline change to only trigger surcharges for sustained regional usage > 1 hour to avoid short-burst noise. I'll raise a follow-up ops ticket.

emily-cs: Thanks. I'll email Greenspan with the expected timeline and include the ops log and SOW excerpt when we reissue.

lucas-fin: Closing loop: goal is to avoid payment delay and maintain revenue accuracy. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
